principals.name: Client
principals.description: The initiating TLS endpoint. It already holds the shared PSK and its identity, the server identity and provisioned 0-RTT parameters; it contributes negotiation offers, constructs the PSK binder, derives the client early traffic keys, and sends the protected 0-RTT application data.

principals.name: Server
principals.description: The responding TLS endpoint. It already holds the shared PSK and its identity, the client identity and provisioned 0-RTT parameters; it validates the binder, contributes the negotiated selections, decides whether to accept early data, derives the early traffic keys, and decrypts/processes accepted 0-RTT data.

values.name: Server
values.description: The server's own identity; the client's knowledge of the server is the SNI provisioned with the PSK.

values.name: PSK
values.description: The pre-shared key obtained out of band, shared by client and server.

values.name: identity
values.description: The PSK identity, provisioned with the out-of-band PSK; the server's PSK store is keyed by it.

values.name: PSK_cipher_suite
values.description: The cipher suite for use with the out-of-band PSK, which must be provisioned to both parties for 0-RTT.

values.name: PSK_ALPN
values.description: The ALPN protocol for use with the out-of-band PSK, provisioned to both parties for 0-RTT if one is used.

values.name: SNI
values.description: The server name indication for use with the out-of-band PSK, provisioned to both parties for 0-RTT if one is used.

values.name: versions
values.description: The protocol versions the client supports.

values.name: cipher_suites
values.description: The cipher suites the client supports.

values.name: ke_modes
values.description: The PSK key exchange modes the client supports.

values.name: named_group_list
values.description: The named groups the client supports, in preference order.

values.name: client_ALPN_protocols
values.description: The ALPN protocols the client supports.

values.name: early_data_policy_Server
values.description: The server's local policy on whether to accept 0-RTT data.
